req.title: Task description accepts long text
req.statement: The system shall accept task descriptions up to at least 1000 characters.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should accept task descriptions up to at least 1000 characters. The tests are designed to verify this functionality by checking valid, boundary, and invalid cases. The positive test ensures that a description of exactly 500 characters is accepted, the boundary test checks the maximum allowed length of 500 characters, and the negative test verifies that a description exceeding 500 characters is rejected.

tests.name: test_create_task_with_valid_description
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
The database is initialized with the pre-loaded data.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a valid task description of 500 characters.
expected: The response contains the task with the correct description.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

description = "X" * 500
response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Valid Task", "description": description, "completed": False})
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["description"] == description

tests.name: test_create_task_with_exceeding_description
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
The database is initialized with the pre-loaded data.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a task description exceeding 500 characters.
expected: The response contains a validation error message.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

description = "X" * 510
response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Invalid Task", "description": description, "completed": False})
assert response.status_code == 422
assert "value_error.any_str.max_length" in response.text
